title: Te Tiaki i Tukuna ki te Awa
intro: I tūtaki tētahi wairua ki tētahi ture kore e taea te whakatutuki, ā, i reira ka noho ko te ora o tētahi pēpi hou i roto i te taumahatanga. Nā te mana o te Atua i ārahi, ka whakarongohia tētahi whakahau whakamataku, ā, ka tukuna tētahi mea ngaro utu nui ki te ia, engari ka whakahokia mai i tētahi ara kāore i kitea i mua.
clues: I noho ahau i raro i te atarangi o tētahi rangatira nanakia i whakahau kia patua ngā pēpi tāne whānau hou.
I tae mai te whakaaweawe a te rangi ki ahau, e whakahau ana kia mahi i tētahi mahi tino pouri, tino mamae hoki.
I whakatakotoria e au taku pēpi utu nui ki roto i tētahi pouaka, ā, i whakatakotoria ki te taha o te awa e rere ana.
I takoto kau tōku ngākau, ā, tata tonu ahau te whakakite i te mea ngaro, engari i whakakaha a Atua i tōku whakaaro.
I tonoa e au tētahi hei whai i te haerenga a te tamaiti ki raro i te awa, i te mea e kahakina ana te pouaka e te ia.
I kitea te tamaiti e te whare o te kaitukino, ā, i te mutunga, ka tūtaki anō māua ko taku tamaiti, ā, ka noho māua hei kaihikihiki.

trial.answer: I whakanohoia e ia tana tamaiti ki roto i te pouaka, ā, i whakatakotoria ki te awa

location.label: Huānga Matua

options: I tūtaki anō ia ki tana tamaiti, ā, i whāngaihia e ia

I whakamatea ia e te kaitukino
I riro ia hei kuīni i Ihipa
I heke ia ki tētahi whenua kē, ā, noho ana i te whenua i peia atu ai
outcome.answer: I tūtaki anō ia ki tana tamaiti, ā, i whāngaihia e ia

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
